title: Local comparison for prescribed graded line fractions
statement: Let S,T,h,A,L,ψ,P,c,ρ,F,j,V,e,α be data as in [def-trf-graded-line-fraction-chart] and [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map], satisfying the displayed frame, recursion, coefficient, fraction, chart, trivialization, and unit-ideal hypotheses. For every point x of the trivialized test scheme W, there is an open U containing x such that the restrictions of j followed by F and of the Proj.fromOfGlobalSections map followed by the relative-Proj chart embedding to U are equal.

source.place: Tag 01NK, lemma-invertible-map-into-proj, local basic-open comparison; Tag 01O9, lemma-invertible-map-into-relative-proj, characterization (3) and affine gluing.

proof.text: The unit irrelevant ideal gives the Mathlib cover by basic opens of images of positive-degree homogeneous elements. Choose a denominator a in degree d>0 nonvanishing at x. Choose an affine B around j(x) inside the image of j and h inverse V.

Compare the restriction adjunction along the open immersion j with the section-normalized tensor-pullback adjunction by uniqueness of left adjoints. Transport the given trivialization e to the restriction functor. Its inverse applied to 1 is a free generator on j(image top); restrict it to B. The adjunction-unit equation shows that its tensor pullback has coefficient 1 under e. Recursion for P, naturality of the power comparison, and the proved pullback_frame_power helper of LineProjChartPullback show the same in every degree. Applying hα and hc then identifies the restriction of α(a) with j.app B of c(a), for every homogeneous a.

Use the proved private coefficient-ring-hom construction and fractionBase_spec_eq helper in GradedLineFractionSameBase. Localize the coefficient ring at the chosen denominator coefficient. The fraction formula hρ and the localization numerator-times-denominator identity identify i.target with the standard fromOfGlobalSections map of this localized ring homomorphism. The localized denominator is a unit, so the irrelevant ideal maps to the unit ideal, including for the zero ring.

The coefficient equality places j(x) in the source chart range, which is its coefficient basic open. This range lies inside the image of j. Lift i.source through j to β. Pull the coefficient equality back along β, use the explicit source-chart ring map, and extend equality from homogeneous elements by direct-sum decomposition. Naturality of Proj.fromOfGlobalSections then identifies β followed by the test map with i.target. The hypothesis hF identifies β followed by j followed by F with the same map. β is an open immersion whose range contains x; precompose with its inverse range isomorphism to obtain exactly the asserted open-neighbourhood equality.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01NK, lemma-invertible-map-into-proj, affine localization construction and uniqueness; Tag 01O9, characterization (3). Formalized by Q9 using the proved private coefficient and pullback-power APIs in the existing library.

lean.statement:
theorem gradedLineFraction_test_local
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {h : T ⟶ S} {A : S.GradedAlgebraData} {L : T.Modules}
    (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h A L)
    (P : ∀ {W : T.Opens}, Γ(L, W) → (n : ℕ) → Γ(L.tensorPow n, W))
    (hP0 : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)), P l 0 = unitSectionsEquiv W 1)
    (hPs : ∀ (W : T.Opens) (l : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ),
      P l (n + 1) = tmulSection l (P l n))
    (c : GradedLineFractionCoefficients h A L)
    (hc : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (hWU : W.1 ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (l : Γ(L, W.1)), IsFreeGenerator l → ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading U n),
      c U W hWU l n a • P l n =
        (L.tensorPow n).val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ψ.component U n a))
    (ρ : ∀ i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away (A.grading i.U) i.e.val →+*
        Localization.Away (i.coefficient c))
    (hρ : GradedLineFractionChart.FractionFormula c ρ)
    (F : T ⟶ A.relProj)
    (hF : ∀ i : GradedLineFractionChart h A L, i.source c ≫ F = i.target c ρ)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ T) (hj : IsOpenImmersion j)
    (V : S.affineOpens) (q : (⊤ : W.Opens) ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1))
    (e : (tensorPullback j).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)
    (α : A.obj V →+* Γ(W, ⊤))
    (hα : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading V n), α a =
      (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤).symm
        ((AlgebraicSpace.trivializedPower e n).hom.app ⊤ (ψ.evaluate j V q n a)))
    (hαgen : Ideal.map α (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (A.grading V)).toIdeal = ⊤) :
    ∀ x : W, ∃ U : W.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      U.ι ≫ j ≫ F =
        U.ι ≫ (Proj.fromOfGlobalSections (A.grading V) α hαgen ≫ A.relProjι V)
